title: Analytics
description: Track revenue, orders, inventory, and cart activity.

help.title: About analytics
help.overview: Your shop's sales, products, stock and carts at a glance. Nothing here changes your data, and each card shows only what you are allowed to see.

sections.title: The period
items: Pick 7 days, 30 days, 90 days or 1 year. Revenue, orders, tax, shipping and top products follow it; stock and carts always show today.
The trend badges compare with the same length of time just before.

sections.title: How it counts
items: Revenue is paid orders, less their refunds.
Amounts are shown in one currency at a time, never mixed: the one you pick, or the one with the most paid orders.
Low stock means less is available than the reorder point; out of stock means nothing is available.
Abandoned carts have items and haven't been touched for over an hour. Signed-in customers get one reminder email for a cart left a day.
Open Product orders, Products or Inventory from a card to act on what it shows.
